actual_scope: Can scripts/experiments/ternary_side.py:verify_invocation_frames emit identical orientation evidence for the historical h=8 and h=9 controls (and keep the ternary-side certificate mathematical payload unchanged aside from the ternary_side.py source pin) by using cleared-denominator Gram products/inverses plus an invocation-local exact frame-transition cache, without editing audit_joint_frames.py, exclusion_circuit.py, disjoint_tensor.py, or partial_swap sources?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after revision-4 interface cards and the leave-alone SharedPoint/partial_swap/exclusion-mask objects were set aside. Profiling named Fraction-heavy product/inverse and repeated rank(sub(F,old)) work inside verify_invocation_frames on the historical small ternary controls. Open question 1 of CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1922 explicitly invited cleared inverse on the ternary frame stream; CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1217 already shipped an opt-in adapter and is credited as the transition-memo method, not re-opened as a second opt-in package.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: the ternary-side certificate's small controls call verify_invocation_frames. A faster identical replay does not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving default-path verify_invocation_frames change with frozen baseline, identical h=8/h=9 frame evidence, pin discipline on the one ternary_side.py binding, registered replay and a measured before/after median. Do not reopen the h=29 DAG construction or run the selected cold frontier replay.
evidence: PASS_TERNARY_FRAME_CLEARED_CACHE via research/ternary-frame-cleared-cache/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_IDENTICAL_TERNARY_FRAME_RECEIPTS via benchmark.py; certificates/ternary-side.json differs from base only in the scripts/experiments/ternary_side.py source pin.
